e2e_breakdown.note: text-encoder and VAE decode run on the host (enable_host_pipeline/enable_decode_components), so only the transformer is a Neuron load; the residual is host text-encode + denoise + host VAE decode.

config_label: tp=4 + TeaCache calibrated adaptive (--teacache-speedup at cadence 2's skip budget, --teacache-calibration per model); tp=4, bf16, TP-sharded transformer + attention_cte self-attn, guidance=1.0 (batch-1 NEFF)
notes: per-step = 511.6 ms/DiT-step (median 503.5, p90 536.0, n=14) — measured the SAME way as H100: inter-step deltas of a real 20-step generate (wrapping NeuronLTX2Application.forward_dit, synced, step 0 excluded), NOT the old isolated synthetic-input timer. 15 DiT calls timed; warm generate 33s; output finite=True.
Default registry shape 512x768x121 also compiles; 480x704x49 used here as the representative fast shape. CFG (guidance>1) needs a batch-2 NEFF.
compile-only run: e2e/per-step come from cold_warm_e2e / step_realloop
e2e_cold = 773 s — TRUE cold start (OS page cache dropped before the run), so the weight load is a real cold disk read.

e2e_warm = 56 s (n=1, warm OS page cache from the immediately-preceding cold run; same session as the 773 s cold start). difflet reloads weights every process, so warm = warm disk cache -> faster load, not a resident model.
